description: End-to-end lifecycle management of 5G UDM subscriber profiles, including provisioning, versioning, activation, rollback, and deletion across multiple network slices and devices.

subscriber_id.description: Globally unique subscriber identifier (e.g., SUPI/MSISDN alias).

profile_id.description: Identifier of a specific UDM subscriber profile instance.

profile_version_id.description: Identifier for a specific version of a subscriber profile configuration.

operation_id.description: Asynchronous lifecycle operation identifier (for long-running tasks).

slice_id.description: Network Slice/Service Instance (S-NSSAI or NSI identifier).

policy_profile.description: Common policy profile schema applied to subscriber profiles.

arp.description: Allocation and Retention Priority (1 highest, 15 lowest).

audit_context.description: Common auditing context for change operations.

requested_by.description: User or system ID initiating the change.

reason.description: Business or operational reason for the change.

ticket_id.description: External change record or incident ticket reference.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: search_subscribers
functions.description: Search for subscribers in UDM based on identifiers, attributes, and status.

tags.description: Key-value tags to match on subscriber metadata.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching subscribers with basic profile summary.

functions.name: get_subscriber_profile
functions.description: Retrieve full UDM subscriber profile including active and historical versions.

include.description: Controls which sections of the profile are returned.

functions.returns: Detailed subscriber profile including requested sections and version metadata.

functions.name: create_subscriber_profile
functions.description: Provision a new subscriber profile in UDM with initial slice and policy configuration.

nai.description: Network Access Identifier for non-3GPP or enterprise.

slice_profiles.description: Initial slice-level configuration for the subscriber.

device_bindings.description: Initial device associations for this subscriber.

activation_policy.description: Controls when the profile becomes active.

functions.returns: Newly created profile_id, initial profile_version_id, and activation status.

functions.name: update_profile_version
functions.description: Create a new version of an existing subscriber profile with updated slice or policy configuration.

base_version_id.description: Existing profile version to clone and modify.

changes.description: Incremental changes to be applied on top of the base version.

slice_definition.description: Required when action is add or modify.

subscription_data_overrides.description: Simple Flat changes to generic subscription data attributes.

activation_plan.description: Defines how this version should be promoted.

segment_criteria.description: Criteria defining which subset of UEs gets the new version.

functions.returns: New profile_version_id, version metadata, and if applicable an operation_id for scheduled or canary activation.

functions.name: validate_profile_configuration
functions.description: Run pre-deployment validation checks on a profile version including policy conflicts, slice compatibility, and quota limits.

dry_run_against_live_udm.description: If true, runs non-intrusive checks against current UDM state.

functions.returns: Validation report including pass/fail per check, warnings, and blocking issues.

functions.name: activate_profile_version
functions.description: Promote a validated profile version to active state and optionally deactivate older versions.

fallback_strategy.description: Defines automatic rollback in case of failures.

functions.returns: Activation result including new active version state and an operation_id for tracking asynchronous rollout.

functions.name: get_profile_operation_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and progress details for a long-running profile lifecycle operation.
functions.returns: Current status, progress metrics, error summaries, and any partial results of the operation.

functions.name: rollback_profile_version
functions.description: Rollback an active profile to a previous stable version, with optional partial/segment-based rollback.

target_version_id.description: Version to rollback to. If omitted, the last known good version is used.

force.description: If true, bypass some pre-checks in emergency scenarios.

functions.returns: Rollback initiation result including operation_id and summary of targeted segments.

functions.name: suspend_or_resume_subscriber
functions.description: Suspend or resume a subscriber across one or more slices, optionally with time-bounded or conditional policies.

conditions.description: Optional conditions controlling when the change takes effect.

functions.returns: Updated subscriber suspension status and any scheduled resume operations.

functions.name: check_realtime_udm_consistency
functions.description: Check consistency of UDM subscriber profile against other network data sources (e.g., AMF, SMF, HSS).
functions.returns: Consistency report summarizing matched/mismatched attributes and recommended remediation steps.

functions.name: retry_profile_operation
functions.description: Retry a failed or partially failed profile lifecycle operation with adjusted parameters if needed.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides to apply on retry.

functions.returns: New operation_id for the retry attempt and a summary of what is being retried.

functions.name: decommission_subscriber_profile
functions.description: Gracefully decommission and delete a subscriber profile from UDM with staged cleanup.
functions.returns: Decommissioning result, including operation_id if asynchronous, and final state (archived/deleted).

functions.name: list_profile_versions
functions.description: List all versions of a subscriber profile with filtering and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of profile versions with their metadata (status, created_at, activated_at, created_by, etc.).

functions.name: search_subscribers_2
functions.description: Faceted search across subscriber records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for udm_profile_lifecycle_management.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of subscriber records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_subscribers_by_status
functions.description: List subscriber records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of subscriber records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_subscriber_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single subscriber record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscriber record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_subscribers
functions.description: Submit a batch of subscriber records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_subscribers
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many subscriber records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_subscribers
functions.description: Soft-archive subscriber records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_subscribers
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of subscriber records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_subscriber_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for subscriber lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_subscriber_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created subscriber event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_subscriber_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a subscriber including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_subscriber_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for udm_profile_lifecycle_management with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_subscriber_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a udm_profile_lifecycle_management operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_subscriber_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled udm_profile_lifecycle_management job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_subscriber_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a udm_profile_lifecycle_management execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_subscriber_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a subscriber prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_subscriber_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a subscriber for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_subscriber_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending subscriber approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_subscriber
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached subscriber to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_subscriber_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a subscriber.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_subscriber_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a subscriber with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_subscriber_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a subscriber and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_subscriber_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a subscriber (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_subscriber_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for udm_profile_lifecycle_management over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_subscriber_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for udm_profile_lifecycle_management.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_subscriber_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed udm_profile_lifecycle_management behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_subscriber_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active udm_profile_lifecycle_management policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_subscriber_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a subscriber and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
